designer: root Codex; positive mechanism design and bounded derivation
name: 按共享载荷最后引用形成的许可组合调度
problem: 地址翻译顺序决定哪些消费者可以合法写出；每个许可的孤立收益可能为0，多个独立许可完成后同一批cell才会退出。现存按walk成本/blocked数或单owneroccupancy的信号丢失此交集。
added_action: 在未首次offer的许可入场点，以真实resident head payload的hard-owner依赖形成最多2许可组合。既不合并权限，也不跳过各自PTW；只允许动态跨SID选择后续服务顺序。

scope.data: aligned immutable Normal source, no remap/revocation/late-fault in finite success witness; separately valid own READs and successful WRITE checks before data exposure; originalR/W/B/ACK preserved
scope.storage_mode: work-conserving shared pool P5 in witness; four per-flow caps3 are maxima, NOT guaranteed reservations; P<sum(caps) stated explicitly. No silently weakening P=sumQ guarantee comparison.
scope.service: one nonpreemptive permission service, costH perleaf request; one trueW service per slot, separate from walking but both costs paid. This is a hand service contract, not native/default DUT or FPGA cycles.
scope.resources: A,C each3 logical copy refs to same3 real cells; B,D each1 copy ref to unique cells. Hard payload5; logicalrefs8; four original WRITE jobs, four own WRITE checks, eight actual W, four real B. Existing real outstanding cap8 is not artificially reduced. Four visible candidate records and independent W-owner transport are new/shared integration costs if current two-bank architecture cannot expose them.

formal_rule.inputs: For each pending candidate q: actual owner/context/generation, pending nonoffered WRITE region and exact owned remaining cost estimate. For each cell b: live hard owners, optional refs, whether each owner includes b in its legal head-ordered drain prefix after its pending grant, heldR/W/lookup/spill pins.
formal_rule.release_set: For eligible setG of at most2 permission candidates, release(G) counts cells for which ALL hard owners can really retire through ordered W after G succeeds; pins/other pending permissions outsideG exclude the cell. Optional refs either retained (nofree) or legally reclaimed with separately priced loss. Grant response itself never decrements payload occupancy.
formal_rule.pressure_select: Only under contested hard capacity select a useful boundedG using release and charged walk/W service; compare singletons AND pairs. Recompute before each individual firstVALID; after a chosen grant succeeds update actual owner graph; continue its partner only if still useful and fairness permits. No heldVALID withdrawal or running-walk preemption.
formal_rule.fairness: Saturating bypass counters at each visible owned candidate; when any reaches finite configuredB, serve oldest bypass-limited candidate before release heuristic. Bound is in successful nonpreemptive service completions, not wall time; finite Hmax and downstream progress additionally needed for time bound.
formal_rule.fallback: No shared cells, absent pressure, stale snapshot/metadata or allpairs0: ordinary RR/oldest/work-aware selection. Each denied result follows real error/drain path; never count hypothetical frees as actual credits.

decisive_witness.pending: A/C WRITE3 and B/D WRITE1, equal H/age/walk level/one pending original header each; source grants already real.
decisive_witness.hand_schedule: Choose A thenC: A permission returnsH; three A trueW completeH+1..H+3 with all shared cells still held by C. C permission returns2H; three C trueW at2H+1..2H+3 release3 cells. Choose B thenD: trueB W atH+1 frees1; trueD W at2H+1 frees another; total2 by2H+3 ifH>3. All four checks/writes/B remain required eventually.
decisive_witness.difference: The singleton largest-release heuristic ranks B,D. A boundedpair evaluator sees a3cell coalition that none of its single permissions can expose. This is a hand difference against that complete heuristic; not a proven speedup over every simple controller or a hardware result.
decisive_witness.counterexample: Before2H+1 the coalition has freed0 while B-first has freed1 sinceH+1. An earlier singlecell demand favors B-first. Long or denied C, head-order loss, held output pin, or W backpressure can erase coalition benefit. Largest number freed alone is not enough; service horizon and actual pressure demand matter.
decisive_witness.global_cost: Coalition prefix pays6W vs singletonprefix2W; no omission. Full workload both orders pay4 checks8W4B. B/ACK latency not converted into pool frees. Under P=sumQ guarantee mode there is no proof of mandatory allocator stall with own unused credit; utility must instead be avoided optional-history loss or occupancy integration.

nearest_controls: ISCA2018 SIMT instruction batch + minimum whole-instruction PWC work + oldest/aging; no dynamic sharedpayload owner input in inspected algorithm.
MASK translationFIFO + stalled-warp/concurrent-PTW data quotas; same translation-priority benefit allowed.
JSAC1997 Concentrate/TATRA/WBA multicast residue retirement; generic all-child retirement principle is prior. Need a fair stage-aware extension, not dismiss it by domain name.
Simple WRITE-first/RR, largestoccupancy, singleton last-owner release with actualW service, and a same-budget two-request continuation rule.
If same real resources allow more parallelwalkers or outstanding child slots, common control gets them; extra candidate records/independent W routing not free.
novelty_conditions: 因为IO-Lite/IXP覆盖共享引用、JSAC覆盖组播残留退休、ISCA覆盖翻译分组，不能把这些原语当贡献。如果动态跨SID载荷依赖真正改变许可入场，并在同预算强对照/完整成本下产生有用差异且准确前作未给该规则，就可以把联合调度作为独立机制贡献。当前仅证明singleton不充分；组合最优/RTL收益/已发表边界仍需决定性证据。
next_decision: Stop performance/model work on the reproduced examples. Retain the dynamic crossSID joint-dependency rule only as a bounded positive design. Find one genuinely reachable and fully charged source/workload where the matched simple continuation/prepermission controls differ, or redesign; no RTL until then.
execution: No model/RTL/Linux implementation, tests, synthesis/build or board. Root formal/hand design only.

critical_self_review.strong_simple_replication: CriticalB now supplies a complete H8 A,C,B,D occupancy+partner control with identical trueW8/AW4/B4 and release curve; root read actual card and checked the sums. This hand scene is concretely reproduced, not merely a suspected equivalent.
critical_self_review.information_family: Formal owner-edge family on P5: AB1,AC1,AD1,BC2 gives flow occupancy(3,3,3,1) and all singleton release0; maxpairBC2 vs oldestA thenbestpartner1. Attaching the low-degreeD edge toB orC yields bestpairAC orAB with identical occupancies. This shows joint owner information differs from independent metrics, not that it is newly published or physically reachable here.
critical_self_review.reachability_gap: The triangle with separate pair-only AB/AC/BC cells and no triple owner cannot come from three single contiguous physical source intervals (interval intersection property). Multiple in-flight COPY ranges could create it, but all original AR/AW/permission/descriptor costs and head order must be demonstrated; do not treat it as oneAR3/oneAW3 native witness.
critical_self_review.simple_preparation_control: Same-interface all-required-permissions-before-source and one-page WRITE lookahead must be compared from original workload start, not forced to inherit the proposed stalled resident snapshot. If they avoid the trigger at same total cost, no end-to-end performance contribution follows.
critical_self_review.native_integration: Critical C and root source read find only2TC lifecycles, public heldVALID lock, firstAW owner lock; 4entrypreparation+actual access_ok+owner result routing+pool/TCWspills are common real costs, not existing free native inputs.
critical_self_review.completed_singleton_control: The contiguous-source P6 equaloccupancyA/B3 scene has occupancy integral138→114 but a concrete stage-awareConcentrate/WBA chooses same B,A,C and matches every actualW/B/ACK; root does not claim an independent algorithm gain.
